name: remote-unfocused-session-is-logged-not-spoken
description: With the focus on one remote session, another session's reply and notifications are still logged (its reply with a folder label), but they are not spoken and do not become the reply Replay speaks. The focused session's reply does. An empty notification reads 'Claude needs your attention.'.
reason: Focus exists so one session can be listened to while others keep working. Muting the others entirely would hide what they did; speaking them would defeat the focus.
source: DESIGN.md v2.2 B (remote session focus); AppState.handleRemoteEvent (isFocused gating)

script.reason: The unfocused session replies: logged, not spoken.
An unfocused notification without a message is logged with the stock text.
The focused session replies: this one is spoken and replayable.

transcript.text: Focus → alpha — only this session is spoken now.
